name: max7219
title: MAX7219 LED display driver
notes: It keeps the picture itself. Chips go in a chain, DOUT to DIN, on one load line: the length of a chain takes no pins.
It drives 8 digits or rows of 8 LEDs. On 5 V a high input starts at 3.5 V, so a chip of 3.3 V falls short.

facts.source: MAX7219/MAX7221 datasheet: V+ 4.0 to 5.5 V, VIH 3.5 V, DOUT for a chain
